activationPopup.description: Activate Qitaf now and start rewarding your customers instantly. By joining, you give your customers the ability to earn points on every purchase and redeem points directly in your store, boosting loyalty and driving repeat sales.

advantageOneDescription: Qitaf is a loyalty program from STC that offers rewards, discounts, and special offers for STC customers. When you activate the Qitaf service in your store, Qitaf customers can redeem their points for purchases from your store or earn new points when they shop.
advantageTwoDescription: Your customers will benefit from redeeming Qitaf program points when they purchase from your online store or earning new points with every successful purchase from your store.
